causes.A: key.tsv is a 348-value by-product, not the source of the reading: of 1,904 groups with a reading, 807 have the value key.tsv gives, 727 are numbers not in key.tsv (273 with a doubtful digit), 301 have another value there (group inside a longer word, homophone, slip, correction)
causes.B: 19 groups graded H (16 words) print the editors' word where Jefferson's interlinear gives another, no bracket in the reading files; 13 more groups print Jefferson's own correction written under the group, unmarked
causes.D: the words come from adjacent plaintext laid along the groups per occurrence (transcription/*.tsv plain column: Jefferson's interlinear and clear sheets, the clerk's decoding in Short's copies) and, for 216 M and 16 I groups, from the editors' printed text
causes.F: about 20 key.tsv values are transcriber notes, marks or phrases ('[struck-through word]', '[above: 1349 ks]', 'because his de-') that the audit decrypts as letters; 44 groups meet a pure note or mark. Also a defect of key.tsv itself
causes.C: small: & to and, Novemb. to November, 1. to 1st.; reading files repeat fragments ('information formation', 'months s') from the way make_texts.py joins groups

after: 124 of 508 words depart (texts compared: 5); unchanged, no key or reading file altered

unmarked_emendations.note: counted in code groups; 16 words. Three carry a query (official?, nature?, how?). A further 13 groups follow Jefferson's own written corrections (1360 blo to is four times, 1190, 1538, 806, 378, 59, 1552, 1396, 1098, 772).

page_statements_false: "Every group was transcribed from the images and its value taken only from those decodings: 348 values (key.tsv)." — 216 groups (M) and 16 (I) take their reading from the editors' text, as the page says further down; the 348 values cover 807 of 1,904 read groups as they stand

"The check is that every value in key.tsv is a contemporary decoding." — about 20 values are transcriber notes, marks or multi-group phrases (1252 '[struck-through word]', 1399 '[above: 1349 ks]', 371 '[below: c]', 1420 'because his de-', 1166 and 1390 both 'indispensibly')

"1,519 are graded H (a contemporary decoding or clear sheet)" — at least 19 of them print the editors' word against Jefferson's decoding, and 13 print his written correction rather than the decoding of the number sent
remaining: Not done: no second key file. A table derived from the plain column would be the reading in key form and would give whole phrases to single groups in the press-copy letters; key.tsv was not hand-edited because attested_key.py writes it and several values need the images. The 124 flagged words were not attributed one by one (group-level counts stand for them). No image re-read. Only interlinear-against-plain was compared; the clear-sheet letters (H by rule) and the M groups were not checked against Founders Online.
